title: Home screen — Your week, ready to print
description: Add a WeekAheadPanel to the Home and DailyWork pages that shows up to 5 upcoming lesson cards (one per period in the user's timetable / scheduler), each pre-filled from buildClassAutoBrief, with one-click Generate per card and Print all at the bottom. Background prefetch warms the cards so Monday morning is instant.
rationale: Move the product from 'tool I open when I have time' to 'tool I open first thing Monday'. This is the single highest-leverage UI change once PR-1/PR-2 have shipped — it surfaces class-aware generation without requiring the teacher to open the form at all.
steps: Audit upstream data first: grep for `loadAllSchedulers`, `nextFireAt`, `isDue` in client/src/lib/scheduler.ts and scheduler-store.ts. Build an in-memory list of the next ≤5 due-or-recently-due scheduler entries across all classes the user owns.
- Lists up to 5 lesson cards: { classLabel, when, suggestedTopic, pupilCount }
- Each card has a primary 'Generate' button that runs aiGenerateWorksheetFromClassBrief for that class (use the helper from PR-1) and routes to /worksheets in Auto mode showing the result.

- Footer 'Print all' button: kicks off all 5 generations in parallel (Promise.allSettled), then calls buildClassPackHtml for each successful one, concatenates the HTML, and opens a single print window with the lot.
- Empty state: if no scheduled lessons, show a small CTA 'Schedule your week →' linking to whichever existing settings page configures the scheduler.
Mount WeekAheadPanel at the top of:

Background prefetch: extend client/src/lib/prefetch.ts with a new export prefetchWeekAhead() that, on user idle (use `requestIdleCallback` with setTimeout fallback), pre-builds the brief for each card and caches the *generated worksheet* in sessionStorage keyed by `weekAhead:{classId}:{date}` so clicking Generate is near-instant if the user is online and has been on the page for ≥10s.

Cache invalidation: invalidate the prefetch entry whenever (a) the scheduler config for that class changes, (b) the generation succeeds and the user opens it (one-shot — don't keep a generated worksheet stale beyond the day), (c) midnight rollover (compare date string to today on Panel mount).
Telemetry: 'weekAhead.viewed', 'weekAhead.card.generated' (classId), 'weekAhead.printAll' (count). Use the same util pattern as PR-2.

- client/src/components/__tests__/WeekAheadPanel.test.tsx — covers: 0/1/5 cards, empty state CTA, Generate click invokes the right helper, Print all uses Promise.allSettled (one failure does not block the rest).
- client/src/lib/__tests__/prefetchWeekAhead.test.ts — covers cache key, idle scheduling, and invalidation on scheduler change.
do_not_touch: Worksheets.tsx (the panel routes to /worksheets but does not import from it)
Class Pack rendering — reuse buildClassPackHtml from PR-3
acceptance_criteria: Home page shows WeekAheadPanel above the tool grid.
DailyWork page shows WeekAheadPanel above the existing daily list.
Each card's Generate button produces a worksheet keyed off buildClassAutoBrief and lands in Worksheets in Auto mode with the result rendered.
Print all generates all up to 5 worksheets in parallel and opens a single print window; one failed generation does not block the others (toast lists failures).
Prefetch primes sessionStorage on idle and clicking Generate is < 200ms when prefetched.
Empty state renders a CTA when no scheduler entries exist.
pnpm run check + pnpm run build pass; both new tests pass.
verification: Manual: configure 2 scheduler entries, open Home, confirm cards appear; click Generate; click Print all.
context_budget_for_fresh_chat: MEDIUM. Home.tsx and DailyWork.tsx are likely small; read in full. scheduler.ts and scheduler-store.ts are small. The new component is ~250 lines.
